source: docs/queries-chart-pick-bar.md, section The bar (numeric, committed now). Nothing here is new; it is that section as numbers.
rule: Jev's chart pick is switched on for Pro only when ALL three hold on labels.json, run once: (1) beats the rules: Jev's pick is acceptable on more items than the rules' pick; (2) significant: an exact two-sided McNemar test on the discordant items (Jev acceptable and rules not, against rules acceptable and Jev not) gives p < mcnemarAlpha; (3) no more harmful picks: the count of items where Jev's pick is labelled harmful is no higher than the rules' count. Held out by whole model: northstar, mssec and smartsheets are the gate. Where Jev did not pick (off, not asked, unsure, the neutral option, a refused answer) the product shows the rules' pick, so that item is scored as the rules' pick.
